description: Use this when the user wants to know their hours in a period, such as how much they tracked this week or the hours per project last month. Shows the totals, the breakdown by project and the hours per day as a card. Takes the same filters and returns the same numbers as statistics_get, so one call is enough. Covers up to one year (366 days) per call. The totals include the running timer's time so far when it matches the filters.

endDate.description: End date for the statistics period (YYYY-MM-DD)

projectId.description: Filter statistics for a specific project

startDate.description: Start date for the statistics period (YYYY-MM-DD)

teamId.description: Filter statistics for a specific team

name: show_statistics

runningTimer.description: The running timer, already included in the totals; absent when no timer runs or it does not match the filters

title: Show Statistics
